headline: Spain deploys military personnel to El Hierro after declaring a migration emergency
label: NEWS
caption:
Spain has sent military personnel to the island of El Hierro after declaring a migration emergency, according to Anadolu Ajansi.

The deployment comes as authorities respond to increasing arrivals and mounting pressure on local resources in the region.

Further details regarding the exact number of deployed personnel and their specific duties are expected as the situation develops.
